title: S3 uploads to Cloudflare R2, MinIO, or other S3-compatible storage fail after upgrading the AWS SDK in January 2025
symptoms: 501 NotImplemented: Header 'x-amz-checksum-crc32' with value (...) not implemented
SignatureDoesNotMatch or InvalidArgument on PutObject that worked before the upgrade
Uploads still succeed against real Amazon S3 with the same code
cause: New SDK releases turned on CRC checksums by default for every upload and checksum validation for downloads. Many S3-compatible services do not accept the extra checksum headers or trailers.
fix: For non-AWS endpoints, set request and response checksum behavior to WHEN_REQUIRED in the client config, or through the shared config file or environment variables. Keep the default for real Amazon S3.
affected: AWS SDK for JavaScript v3 3.729.0 and later; boto3 and botocore 1.36.0 and later; other SDKs and AWS CLI releases from December 2024 onward
